function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies the caller's identity against the account record using a shared secret (last 4 digits of PAN or year of birth). MUST be called before any debt/EMI/amount information is disclosed. The agent must not proceed to STATE 2 until this tool returns verified:true.

account_id.description: Internal account identifier for the loan, e.g. ACC-88392

verification_code.description: The value the caller provided — last 4 digits of PAN, or 4-digit birth year (e.g. 1995).

verification_type.description: Which factor the caller supplied, so the server checks against the right field.

function.name: get_account_details
function.description: Fetches the current overdue amount, due date, and DPD for a verified account. Only call this AFTER verify_customer has returned verified:true — never before, and never if verification failed.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Records a Promise-to-Pay (PTP) commitment once the customer has agreed to a specific date and amount.

ptp_date.description: ISO-8601 date the customer committed to pay by, e.g. 2026-08-21

amount.description: Amount the customer committed to pay (INR). Should match the overdue amount unless a partial arrangement was explicitly authorized.

partial_payment.description: True if this is a partial payment arrangement rather than full settlement.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Sends a payment link to the customer's registered mobile number via SMS and/or WhatsApp. Only call after a PTP has been logged.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Hands the call off to a human collections agent or the grievance desk. Used for hardship cases, disputes, or when the caller explicitly asks for a human.

notes.description: Brief free-text context for the receiving agent.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final outcome of the call. Must be called exactly once, at the end of every call, regardless of path taken.
